title: Charlie's career turns to medical art and imaging after Allagash

tellings.quote: I was training myself to be a school teacher

plain: Charlie Foltz, one of the men who say they were abducted during a 1976 camping trip on the Allagash waterway, says he was training to be a schoolteacher before it happened, and afterwards his career turned to medical art and imaging. He tells Michels this about his own life, as one sign of how the experience changed him.
